text:
Maia: quick design check: compact Autoscale row — when Dedicated pool falls back, how do we surface that without breaking density?
Ben: idea: tiny badge after pool name: 'Fallback active' + warning icon. Click expands details.
Rosa: prefer neutral copy: 'Fallback active' + sublabel 'Reduced performance'. Keep exact ms only in details.
Ethan: interaction: pulse the badge on first trigger and set focus to it once. Dont steal focus repeatedly.
a11y-bot: accessibility notes: badge must have aria-expanded and aria-controls, plus role=region for details. Use an offscreen assertive alert only on initial trigger.
Maia: visuals: 3px orange left accent on the row, 12px icon, high-contrast text. Details panel lists reasons (burst, region, model) and CTAs: Reserve capacity / Adjust SLO.
Ben: analytics: track badge_shown, details_opened, reserve_clicked.
Rosa: will update mocks with keyboard hover/focus states.
Ethan: infra to provide latency ranges for details.
Maia: agreed. we'll iterate after mocks. :thumbsup:
